entries.title: GitOps & Observability Platform
entries.description: A multi-node KIND cluster that reconciles itself from git: Go microservice with Prometheus RED metrics in a minimal non-root image, parameterised Helm chart with HPA and ServiceMonitor, GitHub Actions gating on kubeconform, Helm lint and GHCR publishing, Argo CD with self-healing, and Grafana fed by kube-prometheus-stack plus Loki/Promtail.

entries.title: paykit
entries.description: A local Go CLI that emits correctly-signed webhooks for Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree) and replays adversarial cases — duplicate delivery, reordering, corrupted signatures — so integrations stop being tested by hand through a tunnel. Signatures verified against the official provider SDKs. Explicitly not a hosted service and never calls a real payment API.
